{{Top|leg}}
'''Power adaptors''' were used to plug devices and appliances into the many different designs of [[power access interface]] used across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When the device's [[power coupling]] and rating did not match the interface, power adaptors were used to bridge the difference. [[Udrane Galactic Electronics]] manufactured a [[Universal Power Adaptor]].
